headline: Dec corn at $4.52½ overnight after four lower closes
lead: Dec corn is at $4.52½ overnight, up 3¾ cents from Tuesday's $4.48¾ settle, after four straight lower closes. Feedstuffs said the swift harvest is weighing on corn and soybeans. Every unpriced bushel is worth less than it was a week ago.
teaser: Dec corn at $4.52½ overnight after four lower closes.

one_number.context: Democrats on the Joint Economic Committee estimate farmers face $2.4 billion more in diesel expense this planting and harvest season. WTI is at $101.87 overnight.

sections.title: Grains bounce after the slide
sections.body:
- Dec corn is at **$4.52½** overnight, with Nov soybeans up 6¼ cents to $12.35½ and Chicago wheat up 3½ cents to $6.13¾.
- Feedstuffs said the swift harvest sank corn and soybeans Tuesday, and winter wheat kept struggling.
- AgWeb says grains hit new lows again; today's gains are small against that.
sections.so_what: Harvest supply is still the story; one bounce changes little.

sections.title: Hogs slide, cattle steady
sections.body:
- Dec lean hogs settled Tuesday at **$62.025**, down 4.1% from Monday's $64.675.
- Smithfield said lower pork markets made its third quarter a hard one.
- Oct live cattle settled flat at $230.00. Oct feeders gained 0.8% to $352.80.
sections.so_what: Packers are paying less for hogs while cattle held where they were.

sections.title: Crude tops $100, gas gains
sections.body:
- WTI is at **$101.87** overnight, up 2.0% from Tuesday's $99.90 settle.
- Oilprice reported renewed Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia and a possible new U.S. campaign against Iran.
- Natural gas is at $3.06, up 13.5%, and nothing in the news explains it.
sections.so_what: Diesel stays expensive through harvest while crude sits above $100.

outside_the_pit.title: ARC/PLC election deadline is December 11
outside_the_pit.body: Producers must choose between ARC-CO and PLC for the 2026 crop year by December 11. Nebraska Extension and FSA are holding meetings on the choice.

watch_list.desc: Export sales. Soybean sales firm enough to hold $12.35 would back today's bounce.
Dec corn back under $4.48¾ would say harvest supply is still winning.
U.S. midterms. ING says oil traders expect Iran hostilities may resume after; if not, WTI could slip from $101.

source_summary: Overnight quotes as of 7:01 a.m. CT Wed Oct 28; livestock settles Tue Oct 27; news from Feedstuffs, AgWeb, Oilprice, Farm Policy News

lines: Corn harvest price so far: $4.79 vs $4.62 projected (+3.7%), 19 of 22 trading days in.
Soybeans harvest price so far: $12.70 vs $11.09 projected (+14.5%), 19 of 22 trading days in.
harvest_clock.note: Ours: the average of the daily CBOT settles through Oct 27, figured the way USDA RMA does. RMA posts corn at $4.82 and soybeans at $12.74, both through Oct 23. Window and projected price: USDA RMA, as of Oct 26. Oct 1-31 window, most states.

facts.sentence: On Tuesday, Oct 27, 1,621 of the 1,747 elevators AGSIST reads posted a lower cash corn bid than Monday, 51 a higher one; 161 changed their basis, 43 weaker and 118 stronger.
facts.detail: 75 unchanged; median change 4¢ lower. Biggest state move: Colorado, 5¢ lower (26 elevators).
facts.unit: cents per bushel, median change in cash bid
facts.source: AGSIST elevator network, last posted bid per trading day (data/bids-prev)

facts.sentence: On Tuesday, Oct 27, 1,445 of the 1,532 elevators AGSIST reads posted a lower cash soybean bid than Monday, 19 a higher one; 171 changed their basis, 119 weaker and 52 stronger.
facts.detail: 68 unchanged; median change 10¢ lower. Biggest state move: Michigan, 13¢ lower (16 elevators).
facts.unit: cents per bushel, median change in cash bid
facts.source: AGSIST elevator network, last posted bid per trading day (data/bids-prev)

facts.sentence: Corn basis on Oct 28 ran from 55¢ over December futures in Texas to 87¢ under in North Dakota, state medians of the elevators AGSIST read at 6:07 a.m. CT.
facts.detail: Elevators behind each median: Texas 17, North Dakota 43. 15 states with 15 or more.
facts.unit: cents per bushel between the strongest and weakest state median
facts.source: AGSIST elevator network, state median basis (scripts/basis_method.py, data/basis-states.json)
